architectural_notes: Controle de exibição da opção Administrador condicionado ao valor do campo 'Número de telefone' (exibir apenas se for (91)980115950).

existing_features.title: In the profile setup dialog, hide the "Administrator" role option by default and only reveal it when the user enters the phone number (91)980115950 in the "Phone Number" input (matching by digits, ignoring formatting characters).

Ensure the "Phone Number" input is available to the user at the time they choose a role (so they can unlock the Administrator option), and prevent inconsistent state when the Administrator option becomes hidden again.

new_feature_requests.summary: Ocultar a opção Administrador e exibi-la apenas quando o número de telefone (91)980115950 for inserido no campo 'Número de telefone'.
